note: Round 9 (2026-10-16): candidates for the three combat sounds the rams need (the operator: "generate sound candidates for the crash, crumble and charge"). One literal real-world source per prompt (round 6's finding: field recordings and foley get placed, templates and bells do not). g.crash.name: Creatures collide
prompts: A heavy wooden shield slammed hard against another shield, one deep wooden crash
A large rock dropped onto packed dirt, a deep heavy thud with a little gravel scattering
A sledgehammer hitting a thick wooden post once, a deep solid impact
Two heavy armoured bodies colliding in a tackle, a dull thump with a rattle of armour
A heavy sandbag dropped onto a stone floor, a deep dusty thud

g.crumble.name: Cracks and crumbles
prompts: A clay pot cracking and then crumbling apart, a sharp crack followed by pieces and sand trickling down
A plaster wall cracking and crumbling, a short crack then small chips and dust falling
A small stone statue cracking and collapsing into rubble, a crack then gravel tumbling
A dry brick snapping in two and crumbling, a crisp crack then a short trickle of dust
Dry earth cracking and caving in, a crack then dirt and pebbles pouring down briefly

g.charge.name: Charge at a player
prompts: A heavy wooden staff swung fast through the air, one deep whoosh
A horse breaking into a short gallop on dirt, a few quick heavy hoofbeats rushing forward
A heavy cloak whipping through the air in one fast swing
A large body lunging forward, a fast rush of air and the scrape of a boot on stone
A heavy chain swung once through the air, a quick deep whoosh
